#CECUM
##GFCV cec 16S dataframes and metadata
```{r}
GFCV_cec_16s_ph <- read.table("~/Documents/PhD/ChroMe_PhD/data_omics_GFCV_lima/R_feb2022/16S_gfcv/cecum/feature_table_phylum.txt", header = TRUE, sep = "\t") #load excel with areas

GFCV_cec_16s_ph <- select(GFCV_cec_16s_ph, contains(c("CM","CF")))

colnames(GFCV_cec_16s_ph) <- gsub("X_","",colnames(GFCV_cec_16s_ph))

GFCV_cec_16s_ph <- as.data.frame(t(GFCV_cec_16s_ph))

GFCV_cec_16s_ph <- GFCV_cec_16s_ph %>% select_if(colSums(.) != 0)


# Experimental conditions
gfcv_16s_cond <- data.frame(samplename= rownames(GFCV_cec_16s_ph))

gfcv_16s_cond$type_gfcv <- stri_sub(gfcv_16s_cond$samplename,1,2)

gfcv_16s_cond$group <- stri_sub(gfcv_16s_cond$samplename,1,1)

gfcv_16s_cond$sex <- stri_sub(gfcv_16s_cond$samplename,2,2)

gfcv_16s_cond$batch <- stri_sub(gfcv_16s_cond$samplename,4,4)

gfcv_16s_cond$all <- paste0(gfcv_16s_cond$type_gfcv,stri_sub(gfcv_16s_cond$samplename,4,4))

rownames(gfcv_16s_cond) <- gfcv_16s_cond$samplename

gfcv_16s_cond <- dplyr::select(gfcv_16s_cond, -samplename)


# filtering out taxons not present in at least 80% of one group
groups <- levels(as.factor(gfcv_16s_cond$type_gfcv))
cutoff <- 0.2
thresholds <- round(table(gfcv_16s_cond$type_gfcv) * cutoff)
selected_cols <- lapply(groups, function(i){
  gr <- rownames(gfcv_16s_cond[gfcv_16s_cond$type_gfcv == i,])
  ceros <- GFCV_cec_16s_ph[gr,] == 0
  selc_gr <- which(colSums(ceros) < thresholds[i])
  return(selc_gr)
})
selected_index <- unique(unlist(selected_cols))
GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80 <- GFCV_cec_16s_ph[,selected_index]

# groups <- levels(as.factor(gfcv_16s_cond$all))

dim(GFCV_cec_16s_ph)

lib.size <- apply(GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80, 1, sum) # determine total count for each sample
barplot(lib.size)

boxplot(t(log10(GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80)),las=2)
boxplot(t(log10(GFCV_cec_16s_ph)),las=2)
```

##Exploratory 16S cecum 
######PCA 16S cecum 
```{r}
setwd("~/Documents/PhD/ChroMe_PhD/data_omics_GFCV_lima/R_feb2022/16S_gfcv/cecum/PCA_cec/")

boxplot(t(log10(GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80)),las=2)
boxplot(t(log10(GFCV_cec_16s_cl_80)),las=2)
boxplot(t(log10(GFCV_cec_16s_or_80)),las=2)
boxplot(t(log10(GFCV_cec_16s_fa_80)),las=2)
boxplot(t(log10(GFCV_cec_16s_ge_80)),las=2)
boxplot(t(log10(GFCV_cec_16s_sp_80)),las=2)


# Phylum PCA
p_ph <-mixOmics::pca(GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80, ncomp = 6, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE,
         max.iter = 500, tol = 1e-09, logratio = 'none',   ilr.offset = 0.001,
         V = NULL, multilevel = NULL)

pdf("GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80_PCA_jul2022.pdf")

plotIndiv(p_ph, ind.names = T, group = gfcv_16s_cond$type_gfcv, legend = T, title= "16S phylum 80% by gfcv",ellipse = T, ellipse.level = 0.99)

plotIndiv(p_ph, ind.names = T, group = gfcv_16s_cond$group, legend = T, title= "16S phylum 80% by group",ellipse = T, ellipse.level = 0.99)

plotIndiv(p_ph, ind.names = T, group = gfcv_16s_cond$sex, legend = T, title= "16S phylum 80% by sex",ellipse = T, ellipse.level = 0.99)

plotIndiv(p_ph, ind.names = T, group = gfcv_16s_cond$batch, legend = T, title= "16S phylum 80% by batch",ellipse = T, ellipse.level = 0.99)

plotIndiv(p_ph, ind.names = T, group = gfcv_16s_cond$all, legend = T, title= "16S phylum 80% by all subgroup",ellipse = T, ellipse.level = 0.99)


dev.off()



#ComBat (CB) correction
boxplot(t(log10(GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80)), las=2)
boxplot(log10(GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80))
hist(GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80$`D_0__Bacteria;D_1__Bacteroidetes`)
hist(GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80$`D_0__Bacteria;D_1__Actinobacteria`)


GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80_t <- as.matrix(t(GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80))

GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80_CB <-  ComBat(GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80_t, gfcv_16s_cond$batch)

GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80_CB <- as.data.frame(t(GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80_CB))

table(GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80_CB[GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80_CB<0])
GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80_CB[GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80_CB<0] <- 0.000000001

table(GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80_CB[GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80_CB<0])


boxplot(log10(t(GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80)))
boxplot(log10(t(GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80_CB)))


boxplot(log10(GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80))
boxplot(log10(GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80_CB))

#central log ratio transformation with clr
boxplot(t(log10(GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80_CB)),las=2)
boxplot(log10(GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80_CB),las=2)

GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80_CB_n <- as.data.frame(compositions::clr(GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80_CB))


boxplot(t(log10(GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80_CB_n)),las=2)
boxplot(t(log10(GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80_CB)),las=2)

hist(GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80_CB$`D_0__Bacteria;D_1__Actinobacteria`)
hist(GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80_CB_n$`D_0__Bacteria;D_1__Actinobacteria`)

hist(GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80_CB$`D_0__Bacteria;D_1__Bacteroidetes`)
hist(GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80_CB_n$`D_0__Bacteria;D_1__Bacteroidetes`)


#PCA ComBat + clr corrected
p_ph <-mixOmics::pca(GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80_CB_n, ncomp = 6, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE,
         max.iter = 500, tol = 1e-09, logratio = 'none',   ilr.offset = 0.001,
         V = NULL, multilevel = NULL)

pdf("GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80_CB_clr_PCA_jul2022.pdf")

plotIndiv(p_ph, ind.names = T, group = gfcv_16s_cond$type_gfcv, legend = T, title= "16S cec CB clr 80% phylum by gfcv",ellipse = T, ellipse.level = 0.99)

plotIndiv(p_ph, ind.names = T, group = gfcv_16s_cond$group, legend = T, title= "16S cec CB clr 80% phylum by group",ellipse = T, ellipse.level = 0.99)

plotIndiv(p_ph, ind.names = T, group = gfcv_16s_cond$sex, legend = T, title= "16S cec CB clr 80% phylum by sex",ellipse = T, ellipse.level = 0.99)

plotIndiv(p_ph, ind.names = T, group = gfcv_16s_cond$batch, legend = T, title= "16S cec CB clr 80% phylum by batch",ellipse = T, ellipse.level = 0.99)

plotIndiv(p_ph, ind.names = T, group = gfcv_16s_cond$all, legend = T, title= "16S cec CB clr 80% phylum by all subgroups",ellipse = T, ellipse.level = 0.99)
```

######Wilcoxon all comp
```{r}

setwd("~/Documents/PhD/ChroMe_PhD/data_omics_GFCV_lima/R_feb2022/16S_gfcv/cecum/boxplot_cec/")


#Phylum
pdf("GFCV_cec_16s_ph_FvsM_boxplot_jul2022.pdf")
for (i in colnames(GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80_CB_n)) {
  compound <- GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80_CB_n[,i,drop=T]      # creats a temp list of values for each compound in col i
  plot <- ggplot(GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80_CB_n, aes(x=gfcv_16s_cond$sex, y=compound, fill=gfcv_16s_cond$sex), main= i) + 
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2, height = 0, size= 2.5,aes(shape=gfcv_16s_cond$type_gfcv)) +
    #geom_dotplot(binaxis = "y", stackdir = "center", method = "histodot") +
    ggtitle(i) +
    xlab("Condition") + ylab("clr relative abundance") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=c("#B73557FF", "#218E8DFF"), 
                      name="Experimental\nCondition",
                      breaks=c("F","M"),
                      labels=c("Female (F)", "Male (M)")) +
    geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("F","M")), 
                map_signif_level=TRUE, step_increase = 0.07)+
    stat_compare_means()
  print(plot)                # plots for each compound
}
dev.off()

    #geom_dotplot(binaxis = "y", stackdir = "center", method = "histodot") +
    ggtitle(i) +
    xlab("Condition") + ylab("clr relative abundance") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=c("#B73557FF", "#218E8DFF"), 
                      name="Experimental\nCondition",
                      breaks=c("F","M"),
                      labels=c("Female (F)", "Male (M)")) +
    geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("F","M")),

    stat_compare_means()
  print(plot)                # plots for each compound
}
```

```{r}
#dataframe with conditions first col

tst <- dplyr::bind_cols(gfcv_16s_cond,GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80_CB_n)

write.csv(tst, "GFCV_cec_16s_ph_4_stats.csv")

df_tst_out <- data.frame()


for(j in colnames(tst[,6:13])){
    cond <- tst$type_gfcv
    micb <- tst[,j]
    temp_df <- data.frame(micb,cond)
    wt <- compare_means(micb~cond, temp_df, method = "wilcox.test")
    wt$.y. <- j
    means <- temp_df %>% group_by(cond) %>%
      sumjulise(avg = mean(micb))
    colnames(means) <- c("cond",j)
      log2FC<- c(log2(dplyr::filter(means, cond == "CF")[,2]/dplyr::filter(means, cond == "CM")[,2]))
    wt <- dplyr::bind_cols(wt,log2FC=unlist(log2FC))
        df_tst_out <- dplyr::bind_rows(df_tst_out,wt)
        df_tst_out <- dplyr::select(df_tst_out, -p, -p.format)
  
}
```

#####Correlations heatmap
```{r}
setwd ("~/Documents/PhD/ChroMe_PhD/data_omics_GFCV_lima/R_feb2022/16S_gfcv/cecum/")


# #####################TEST with counts encoded ID######################
# test_counts <- read_tsv("~/Documents/PhD/ChroMe_PhD/data_omics_GFCV_lima/R_feb2022/mixOmics_MOFA/MOFA/data_4_mofa/cec_16s_counts_encoded.txt")
# 
# test <- GFCV_cec_16s_sp_80_CB[,3:ncol(GFCV_cec_16s_sp_80_CB)] #not clr transformed
# cor_test <- sparcc(test)
# 
# ######################################################################


col<- colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(50)


#Phylum
GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80_CB_n$gfcv <- stri_sub(rownames(GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80_CB_n),1,1)
GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80_CB_n$sex <- stri_sub(rownames(GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80_CB_n),2,2)

GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80_CB_n <- relocate(GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80_CB_n, gfcv, sex)

tst <- GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80_CB_n



#Spearman
pdf("GFCV_cec_16s_ph_correlations_spearman_jul2022.pdf", width = 10)
for(i in colnames(tst[,1:2])){
    cond <- tst[,i]
    if(i == "sex"){
      mat1 <- dplyr::filter(tst, cond == "F")
      mat1<- dplyr::select(mat1,-sex, -gfcv)
      mat2 <- dplyr::filter(tst, cond == "M")
      mat2<- dplyr::select(mat2,-sex, -gfcv)
      if(nrow(mat1)<nrow(mat2)){
        mat1<- rbind(mat1,NA)
      }
      if(nrow(mat1)>nrow(mat2)){
        mat2<- rbind(mat2,NA)
      }
      res_sp<-dplyr::bind_cols(mat1,mat2)
      comp <- "FvM"
      res_sp <- rcorr(as.matrix(res_sp),type = "spearman")
      cor_sp_mat <- as.matrix(res_sp$r)
      cor_names <- c(paste0(colnames(mat1), "_F"),paste0(colnames(mat1), "_M"))
      colnames(cor_sp_mat) <- cor_names
      rownames(cor_sp_mat) <- cor_names
      # image(cor_sp_mat, col=col)
      heat <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(cor_sp_mat,name="correlation",
                              column_title=paste0("Spearman_cor_Phy_",comp),
                              row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6),
                              column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6),
                              column_split = 2, row_split = 2,
                                        cluster_rows = cluster_within_group(cor_sp_mat, as.factor(gsub("^.*\\_","",cor_names))),
                                        cluster_columns = cluster_within_group(cor_sp_mat, as.factor(gsub("^.*\\_","",cor_names))))
      print(heat)
     }
}
dev.off()
```

```{r}
setwd ("~/Documents/PhD/ChroMe_PhD/data_omics_GFCV_lima/R_feb2022/16S_gfcv/cecum/")

flattenCorrMatrix <- function(cor_sp_mat, pval_sp_mat) {
  ut <- upper.tri(cor_sp_mat)
  data.frame(
    row = rownames(cor_sp_mat)[row(cor_sp_mat)[ut]],
    column = rownames(cor_sp_mat)[col(cor_sp_mat)[ut]],
    cor  =(cor_sp_mat)[ut],
    p = pval_sp_mat[ut]
    )
}

#Phylum
tst <- GFCV_cec_16s_ph_80_CB_n

df_tst_out <- data.frame()

#Spearman
for(i in colnames(tst[,1:2])){
    cond <- tst[,i]
     if(i == "gfcv"){
      mat2 <- dplyr::filter(tst, cond == "C")
      mat2<- dplyr::select(mat2,-sex, -gfcv)
      res_sp<-mat2
      comp <- "CvC"
      res_sp <- rcorr(as.matrix(res_sp),type = "spearman")
      cor_sp_mat <- as.matrix(res_sp$r)
      cor_names <- paste0(colnames(mat2), "_C")
      colnames(cor_sp_mat) <- cor_names
      rownames(cor_sp_mat) <- cor_names
      pval_sp_mat <- as.matrix(res_sp$P)
      colnames(pval_sp_mat) <- cor_names
      rownames(pval_sp_mat) <- cor_names
      cor_pval_mat <- flattenCorrMatrix(cor_sp_mat, pval_sp_mat)
      cor_pval_mat <- as.data.frame(cor_pval_mat)
      cor_pval_mat <- dplyr::arrange(cor_pval_mat, p)
      cor_pval_mat <- dplyr::bind_cols(comp,cor_pval_mat)
      cor_pval_mat <- dplyr::distinct(cor_pval_mat)
      cor_pval_mat$padj <- p.adjust(cor_pval_mat$p, method = "BH")
      df_tst_out <- dplyr::bind_rows(df_tst_out,cor_pval_mat)

tst <- GFCV_cec_16s_fa_80_CB_n

df_tst_out <- data.frame()

#Spearman
for(i in colnames(tst[,1:2])){
    cond <- tst[,i]
     if(i == "gfcv"){
      mat2 <- dplyr::filter(tst, cond == "C")
      mat2<- dplyr::select(mat2,-sex, -gfcv)
      res_sp<-mat2
      comp <- "CvC"
      res_sp <- rcorr(as.matrix(res_sp),type = "spearman")
      cor_sp_mat <- as.matrix(res_sp$r)
      cor_names <- paste0(colnames(mat2), "_C")
      colnames(cor_sp_mat) <- cor_names
      rownames(cor_sp_mat) <- cor_names
      pval_sp_mat <- as.matrix(res_sp$P)
      colnames(pval_sp_mat) <- cor_names
      rownames(pval_sp_mat) <- cor_names
      cor_pval_mat <- flattenCorrMatrix(cor_sp_mat, pval_sp_mat)
      cor_pval_mat <- as.data.frame(cor_pval_mat)
      cor_pval_mat <- dplyr::arrange(cor_pval_mat, p)
      cor_pval_mat <- dplyr::bind_cols(comp,cor_pval_mat)
      cor_pval_mat <- dplyr::distinct(cor_pval_mat)
      cor_pval_mat$padj <- p.adjust(cor_pval_mat$p, method = "BH")
      df_tst_out <- dplyr::bind_rows(df_tst_out,cor_pval_mat)
     }
    if(i == "sex"){
      mat1 <- dplyr::filter(tst, cond == "F")
      mat1<- dplyr::select(mat1,-sex, -gfcv)
      mat2 <- dplyr::filter(tst, cond == "M")
      mat2<- dplyr::select(mat2,-sex, -gfcv)
      if(nrow(mat1)<nrow(mat2)){
        mat1<- rbind(mat1,NA)
      }
      if(nrow(mat1)>nrow(mat2)){
        mat2<- rbind(mat2,NA)
      }
      res_sp<-dplyr::bind_cols(mat1,mat2)
      comp <- "FvM"
      res_sp <- rcorr(as.matrix(res_sp),type = "spearman")
      cor_sp_mat <- as.matrix(res_sp$r)
      cor_names <- c(paste0(colnames(mat1), "_F"),paste0(colnames(mat1), "_M"))
      colnames(cor_sp_mat) <- cor_names
      rownames(cor_sp_mat) <- cor_names
      pval_sp_mat <- as.matrix(res_sp$P)
      colnames(pval_sp_mat) <- cor_names
      rownames(pval_sp_mat) <- cor_names
      cor_pval_mat <- flattenCorrMatrix(cor_sp_mat, pval_sp_mat)
      cor_pval_mat <- as.data.frame(cor_pval_mat)
      cor_pval_mat <- dplyr::arrange(cor_pval_mat, p)
      cor_pval_mat <- dplyr::bind_cols(comp,cor_pval_mat)
      cor_pval_mat <- dplyr::distinct(cor_pval_mat)
      cor_pval_mat$padj <- p.adjust(cor_pval_mat$p, method = "BH")
      df_tst_out <- dplyr::bind_rows(df_tst_out,cor_pval_mat)
      # image(cor_sp_mat, col=col)
     }
}
```

```{r}
GFCV_col_16s_ph <- read.table("~/Documents/PhD/ChroMe_PhD/data_omics_GFCV_lima/R_feb2022/16S_gfcv/colon/feature_table_phylum.txt", header = TRUE, sep = "\t") #load excel with areas

GFCV_col_16s_ph <- select(GFCV_col_16s_ph, contains(c("CM","CF")))

colnames(GFCV_col_16s_ph) <- gsub("X_","",colnames(GFCV_col_16s_ph))

GFCV_col_16s_ph <- as.data.frame(t(GFCV_col_16s_ph))

GFCV_col_16s_ph <- GFCV_col_16s_ph %>% select_if(colSums(.) != 0)


# Experimental conditions
gfcv_16s_cond <- data.frame(samplename= rownames(GFCV_col_16s_ph))

gfcv_16s_cond$type_gfcv <- stri_sub(gfcv_16s_cond$samplename,1,2)

gfcv_16s_cond$group <- stri_sub(gfcv_16s_cond$samplename,1,1)

gfcv_16s_cond$sex <- stri_sub(gfcv_16s_cond$samplename,2,2)

gfcv_16s_cond$batch <- stri_sub(gfcv_16s_cond$samplename,4,4)

gfcv_16s_cond$all <- paste0(gfcv_16s_cond$type_gfcv,stri_sub(gfcv_16s_cond$samplename,4,4))

rownames(gfcv_16s_cond) <- gfcv_16s_cond$samplename

gfcv_16s_cond <- dplyr::select(gfcv_16s_cond, -samplename)


# filtering out taxons not present in at least 80% of one group
groups <- levels(as.factor(gfcv_16s_cond$type_gfcv))
cutoff <- 0.2
thresholds <- round(table(gfcv_16s_cond$type_gfcv) * cutoff)
selected_cols <- lapply(groups, function(i){

})
```

```{r}
#Phylum
pdf("GFCV_col_16s_ph_FvsM_boxplot_jul2022.pdf")
for (i in colnames(GFCV_col_16s_ph_80_CB_n)) {
  compound <- GFCV_col_16s_ph_80_CB_n[,i,drop=T]      # creats a temp list of values for each compound in col i
  plot <- ggplot(GFCV_col_16s_ph_80_CB_n, aes(x=gfcv_16s_cond$sex, y=compound, fill=gfcv_16s_cond$sex), main= i) + 
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2, height = 0, size= 2.5,aes(shape=gfcv_16s_cond$type_gfcv)) +
    #geom_dotplot(binaxis = "y", stackdir = "center", method = "histodot") +
    ggtitle(i) +
    xlab("Condition") + ylab("clr relative abundance") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=c("#B73557FF", "#218E8DFF"), 
                      name="Experimental\nCondition",
                      breaks=c("F","M"),
                      labels=c("Female (F)", "Male (M)")) +
    geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("F","M")), 
                map_signif_level=TRUE, step_increase = 0.07)+
    stat_compare_means()
  print(plot)                # plots for each compound
}
```

####Wilcox csv results
```{r}
#dataframe with conditions first col
#Phylum###################################################

tst <- dplyr::bind_cols(gfcv_16s_cond,GFCV_col_16s_ph_80_CB_n)

write.csv(tst, "GFCV_col_16s_ph_4_stats.csv")

df_tst_out <- data.frame()


for(j in colnames(tst[,6:13])){
    cond <- tst$type_gfcv
    micb <- tst[,j]
    temp_df <- data.frame(micb,cond)
    wt <- compare_means(micb~cond, temp_df, method = "wilcox.test")
    wt$.y. <- j

}
```

#####Correlations heatmap
```{r}
setwd ("~/Documents/PhD/ChroMe_PhD/data_omics_GFCV_lima/R_feb2022/16S_gfcv/colon/")


col<- colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(50)


#Phylum
GFCV_col_16s_ph_80_CB_n$gfcv <- stri_sub(rownames(GFCV_col_16s_ph_80_CB_n),1,1)
GFCV_col_16s_ph_80_CB_n$sex <- stri_sub(rownames(GFCV_col_16s_ph_80_CB_n),2,2)

GFCV_col_16s_ph_80_CB_n <- relocate(GFCV_col_16s_ph_80_CB_n, gfcv, sex)

tst <- GFCV_col_16s_ph_80_CB_n



#Spearman
pdf("GFCV_col_16s_ph_correlations_spearman_jul2022.pdf", width = 10)
for(i in colnames(tst[,1:2])){
    cond <- tst[,i]
    if(i == "sex"){
      mat1 <- dplyr::filter(tst, cond == "F")
      mat1<- dplyr::select(mat1,-sex, -gfcv)
      mat2 <- dplyr::filter(tst, cond == "M")
      mat2<- dplyr::select(mat2,-sex, -gfcv)
      if(nrow(mat1)<nrow(mat2)){
        mat1<- dplyr::slice(mat1, 1:8)
        mat2<- dplyr::slice(mat2, 1:8)
      }
      if(nrow(mat1)>nrow(mat2)){
        mat2<- dplyr::slice(mat2, 1:8)
        mat1<- dplyr::slice(mat1, 1:8)
      }
      res_sp<-dplyr::bind_cols(mat1,mat2)
      comp <- "FvM"
      res_sp <- rcorr(as.matrix(res_sp),type = "spearman")
      cor_sp_mat <- as.matrix(res_sp$r)
      cor_names <- c(paste0(colnames(mat1), "_F"),paste0(colnames(mat1), "_M"))
      colnames(cor_sp_mat) <- cor_names
      rownames(cor_sp_mat) <- cor_names
      # image(cor_sp_mat, col=col)
      heat <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(cor_sp_mat,name="correlation",
                              column_title=paste0("Spearman_cor_Phy_",comp),
                              row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6),
                              column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6),
                              column_split = 2, row_split = 2,
                                        cluster_rows = cluster_within_group(cor_sp_mat, as.factor(gsub("^.*\\_","",cor_names))),
                                        cluster_columns = cluster_within_group(cor_sp_mat, as.factor(gsub("^.*\\_","",cor_names))))
      print(heat)
     }
}
dev.off()
```

```{r}
setwd ("~/Documents/PhD/ChroMe_PhD/data_omics_GFCV_lima/R_feb2022/16S_gfcv/colon/")

flattenCorrMatrix <- function(cor_sp_mat, pval_sp_mat) {
  ut <- upper.tri(cor_sp_mat)
  data.frame(
    row = rownames(cor_sp_mat)[row(cor_sp_mat)[ut]],
    column = rownames(cor_sp_mat)[col(cor_sp_mat)[ut]],
    cor  =(cor_sp_mat)[ut],
    p = pval_sp_mat[ut]
    )
}

#Phylum
tst <- GFCV_col_16s_ph_80_CB_n

df_tst_out <- data.frame()

#Spearman
for(i in colnames(tst[,1:2])){
    cond <- tst[,i]
     if(i == "gfcv"){
      mat2 <- dplyr::filter(tst, cond == "C")
      mat2<- dplyr::select(mat2,-sex, -gfcv)
      res_sp<-mat2
      comp <- "CvC"
      res_sp <- rcorr(as.matrix(res_sp),type = "spearman")
      cor_sp_mat <- as.matrix(res_sp$r)
      cor_names <- paste0(colnames(mat2), "_C")
      colnames(cor_sp_mat) <- cor_names
      rownames(cor_sp_mat) <- cor_names
      pval_sp_mat <- as.matrix(res_sp$P)
      colnames(pval_sp_mat) <- cor_names
      rownames(pval_sp_mat) <- cor_names
      cor_pval_mat <- flattenCorrMatrix(cor_sp_mat, pval_sp_mat)
      cor_pval_mat <- as.data.frame(cor_pval_mat)
      cor_pval_mat <- dplyr::arrange(cor_pval_mat, p)
      cor_pval_mat <- dplyr::bind_cols(comp,cor_pval_mat)
      cor_pval_mat <- dplyr::distinct(cor_pval_mat)
      cor_pval_mat$padj <- p.adjust(cor_pval_mat$p, method = "BH")
      df_tst_out <- dplyr::bind_rows(df_tst_out,cor_pval_mat)
     }
    if(i == "sex"){
```
